segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the last four digits on the account phone number?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Daniel at Northstar Controls. Last four should be 4182.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it, thanks. I have Northstar Controls pulled up in the admin console. What can I help with today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We received invoice 104782 for March, and there’s a $375 training line on it that shouldn’t be there. We didn’t request training this month, so I’m trying to get that corrected before our AP run on Friday.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, I see the invoice in the billing tool. Give me just a second to check the order notes and the ticketing system.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, so I found the note. That line was attached from an older implementation package and shouldn’t have carried forward. I’m going to open a billing correction ticket and route it to finance for approval today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Do you know if we should hold payment or pay the rest?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Paying the undisputed balance is fine. The remaining amount is $2,640. I’ll note that in ticket 583219, and finance will either reissue the invoice or apply a credit memo, usually within one business day.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, please send that to billing@northstarcontrols.com and copy me.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the ticket confirmation in the next few minutes, and you’ll see the update from finance by end of day tomorrow.
